title: Same-frame optional weather, water reflections and experimental cloud fixtures

do.text: Run godot-console --headless --path godot/GUO res://src/Render/SpeedMode/Weather/SpeedModeWeatherProbe.tscn. Require exit 0 and [speed-weather] PASS. Integration adds this as its smoke line.

steps.say: Check rain intensity, wetness timing, wind and covered-water impact rejection without a shard.

do.text: With a Godot slot, run godot-console --path godot/GUO res://src/Render/Water/WaterLightingProbe.tscn. Set GUO_WATER_PROBE_OUT to the evidence stills directory. Require exit 0 and [water-lighting] PASS. Set GUO_WATER_BASELINE_INCLUDE to the pre-change water include for six old-model byte comparisons.

steps.say: Compile and render lighting water against a half-float linear light target at 1280x720; inspect day, night, lamp, wind and rain stills.

do.text: With a Godot slot, run godot-console --path godot/GUO res://src/Render/SpeedMode/Weather/SpeedModeRainProbe.tscn. GUO_WEATHER_PROBE_OUT names the evidence stills directory. Require exit 0 and [speed-rain] PASS: covered pixels zero, splashes only floors, drips only exposed roof edge, same-time determinism, surface-origin rebase invariance and fallback.

steps.say: Verify the procedural rain pass against the synthetic surface buffer before core integration.

do.text: With a Godot slot, run godot-console --path godot/GUO res://src/Render/SpeedMode/Weather/SpeedModeFogProbe.tscn. GUO_WEATHER_PROBE_OUT names the evidence stills directory. Require exit 0 and [speed-fog] PASS: distance/height attenuation, covered/missing parity, quarter density, wind/time, origin invariance and exact toggle/fallback restoration.

steps.say: Verify synthetic world-space mist. Storm-brewing3 uses count/70, rain0 uses one quarter; snow2 and storm-approach1 contribute zero. Morning haze (%) adds a constant and defaults to zero; Fog applies only to Lighting speed mode.

do.text: With a Godot slot, run SpeedModeWetProbe.tscn and SpeedModeReflectionProbe.tscn under res://src/Render/SpeedMode/Weather/. Require wet PASS and reflection PASS. Test floor darkening, allowlisted rings/light response, four nearest reflection taps in wet/water, upright/wall classes, d/8 height and XY column consistency, wrong height/class rejection, 1x/2x art grids, cover/off, origin and storey-offset parity. No object base-Z input is needed.

With an admitted Godot slot, run res://src/Render/SpeedMode/Weather/SpeedModeWeatherRuntimeProbe.tscn. Require [speed-weather-runtime] PASS and exit0: current publication, surface-only fallback, covered-pixel parity, invalidation, stale tick/group safety and exact main-off restoration.

With an admitted Godot slot, run res://src/Render/SpeedMode/Weather/SpeedModeCloudProbe.tscn. Require [speed-cloud] PASS and exit0. Check disabled/4x exact original pixels, visible5x below/above plane, wind motion, clouds beyond5x without surface/light, pin clearance and exact fallback. Live camera uses existing ExperimentalWorldOverview, continuous4..5 entry, overview beyond5; lead owns that integration.

With an admitted Godot slot and external GUO_CLOUD_SCENE_OUT, run the actual NativeCloudSceneProbe.tscn. Require native4/4.5/5/overview6 and producer-unload/queued-unload PASS: completed scene clears Current surface/light and optional targets; re-entered scene can produce again; unloading immediately after DrawFrame before FramePreDraw cannot republish. No accounts or shard connections; preserve known shutdown warnings separately.

Synthetic evidence establishes only the tested fixtures. Scene lifecycle/pool reset hooks and both native/overview camera calls are lead-owned. Styled water retains canvas fallback; classic-water class6 reflections use the speed overlay. Live bank and camera on/off captures remain integrated acceptance. No frame-time claim.
